question: Which of the following is/are NOT a part of the financial sector?
solution:
The correct answer is the __**Department of Agriculture and Farmer's Welfare**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare **is not a part of the financial sector: 
 
• **Financial sector**
 
 
• The financial sector is **made up of companies and individuals that offer financial services, such as banks, commercial institutions, brokers, and mortgage lenders. **
 
 
 
• **Non-financial sector**
 
 
• The non-financial sector is made up of independent legal companies and market producers that produce goods and offer non-financial services. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Investment banks**

 
 
• Provide services to large corporations and institutional investors, and are involved in complex financial transactions.
 
• Investment banks may underwrite the issuance of new securities, manage initial public offerings (IPOs), and provide advice on mergers, acquisitions, and reorganizations. 
 
 
 
• **Commercial banks**
 
 
• Provide services to consumers and small and medium-sized businesses, and are involved in accepting deposits, making loans, and safeguarding assets.
 
• Some examples of commercial banks include the State Bank of India (SBI), Housing Development Finance Corporation (HDFC) Bank, and Industrial Credit and Investment Corporation of India (ICICI) Bank. 
 
 
 
• **Stock exchange operations**
 
 
• Provide a continuous market for the purchase and sale of securities, and facilitate the evaluation of securities.
 
• Stock exchanges also encourage capital formation and provide safety and security in dealings.
